issues.name: Data Centers
issues.hook: Governor Newsom signed a package of seven data center bills on September 21, 2026, covering electricity rates, water-use reporting and environmental review.
sources: Bloomberg Law: Newsom Signs Bills Regulating Data Centers’ Water, Energy Use
KQED: Newsom signs new restrictions on data center development
Greenberg Traurig: California enacts comprehensive regulatory framework for data centers

issues.name: AI Regulation
issues.hook: Lawmakers passed 26 AI-related bills on the last day of the session, including child-safety rules for companion chatbots.
sources: AI Weekly: California adjourns with 26 AI bills passed
Fenwick: California enacts comprehensive child safety laws targeting AI chatbots

issues.name: Kids’ Online Safety
issues.hook: New laws on companion chatbots and social media for minors were signed in September 2026.
sources: Benton Institute: Governor Newsom signs the strongest child safety chatbot and social media laws in the nation
Fenwick: California enacts comprehensive child safety laws targeting AI chatbots

issues.name: Autonomous and Driver-Assist Vehicles
issues.hook: New DMV rules effective May 2026 let police issue notices to robotaxi companies for moving violations.
sources: NBC Palm Springs: Robotaxis can’t run from the law, new DMV rules allow police to ticket driverless cars

issues.name: Guns
issues.hook: Governor Newsom signed a package of 10 gun bills on September 26, 2026, including limits on 3D-printed guns and new safety training.
sources: Governor’s office: Newsom signs new bills to further prevent gun violence
NBC Palm Springs: Newsom signs 10 California gun safety bills into law

issues.name: Energy Costs and Clean Energy
issues.hook: Electricity and gasoline prices remain among the highest in the nation, and lawmakers have sent packages meant to bring them down.

issues.name: Wildfire, Insurance and Rebuilding
issues.hook: Newsom signed wildfire recovery bills in September 2026 on smoke-damage testing, insurance coverage and mortgage forbearance.
sources: Spectrum News: Newsom wildfire recovery system
United Policyholders: Wildfire safety leads Commissioner Lara’s agenda as Newsom signs sponsored bills

issues.name: Immigration Enforcement
issues.hook: California’s ban on masked law enforcement took effect in January 2026, alongside new limits on immigration agents at schools and hospitals.
sources: Arise News: California bans police and ICE agents from wearing masks on duty

issues.name: Housing and Permitting
issues.hook: Governor Newsom signed a round of housing and permitting bills on September 29 and 30, 2026, reported as taking effect in January 2027.
sources: JD Supra: California building permits and CEQA updates
